parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to start displaying results from. Minimum value: 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time of the scene orchestration rule logs. Unit: seconds. Specify a UNIX timestamp.

> You can query rule execution logs only for the last 30 days.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the scene orchestration rule. Invoke the [QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~) operation to obtain the scene orchestration rule ID.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start time of the scene orchestration rule logs. Unit: seconds. Specify a UNIX timestamp.

> You can query rule execution logs only for the last 30 days.

parameters.name: TraceId
parameters.description: The trace ID of the scene orchestration rule log. Invoke the [QuerySummarySceneRuleLog](~~169511~~) operation to obtain this ID.
